title: Remote Financial Services Agent (Independent Contractor) – Inbound Card & Account Support
locations: United States
descriptionHtml:
Set your own hours, take inbound banking card calls from home, and earn up to $350 in certification bonuses. The contract has a pool of 20,000+ hours of work available every month.

Earnings at a Glance

  • $15.00–$17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives

  • $300 certification bonus once you complete 200 productive hours

  • +$50 bonus if you certify within 6 weeks

  • Choose your own hours. Coverage runs 24/7, every day

  • Remote, U.S.-based, 1099 independent contractor

The Opportunity

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. They might be activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. These moments matter, and you're the person who makes them go smoothly.

What the Work Involves

  • Inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions

  • Payments, transfers, and disputes, handled accurately and securely

  • Identity verification and strict security and compliance protocols on every call

  • Spotting potential fraud and helping resolve it with composure

  • Accurate documentation of every interaction

You're a Fit If You Bring

  • Clear, empathetic phone communication, even when callers are stressed

  • Care for protecting sensitive financial information

  • Comfort moving between multiple systems at once

  • Composure and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong plus: banking, card, financial services, or contact center experience

Your Path to Starting Work

  1. Week 1: Apply. Create your ShyftOff account and apply to the Financial Services campaign.

  2. Weeks 2–3: Screening & credentialing. Federal background check, fingerprinting, drug screening, and credential issuance.

  3. Weeks 4–5: Certification. Simulations and scored mock calls. Standards and examples of required work product are demonstrated.

  4. Week 6: Practice calls & go-live. Show that your work meets the program's accuracy and quality standards, then start choosing open hours.

Screening Cost: Please Read Before Applying

This is a federally backed program, so every contractor must complete third-party credentialing before taking live calls. As an independent contractor, you pay these providers directly:

  • Extensive federal background check

  • Fingerprinting

  • Drug screening

  • YubiKey security device (yours to keep)

Total: $299, paid to third-party providers. It's due only when you move into credentialing, not at sign-up.

What You'll Need

  • Ability to pass federal background, fingerprint, and drug screening

  • A quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet

  • Commitment to completing self-paced certification (about 6 weeks)

How to Apply

  1. Create your agent account at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

  2. Apply to the Financial Services campaign from your dashboard

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. You set your own schedule, work remotely, and provide your own workspace and equipment.

At Sneed & Mitchell, the work we do matters. For thousands of Americans, we’re their last line of defense against insurance companies and large corporations or dangerous products. From attorneys to client support staff, and creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for our clients.

Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized individual to join our law office as a Case Manager. The Case Manager will be responsible for maintaining and organizing physical and digital files, ensuring accurate and efficient retrieval of documents, and supporting the overall administrative functions of the office. The ideal candidate will have excellent organizational skills, a strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

  1. File Management:

    • Organize, label, and maintain physical files in accordance with established filing systems and procedures.
    • Create and update file records, ensuring accuracy and completeness of information.
    • Sort and categorize documents for easy retrieval and efficient storage.
    • Assist in transitioning physical files to digital format, scanning and indexing documents as necessary.
    • Maintain confidentiality and security of all files and documents.

  2. Document Retrieval and Distribution:

    • Retrieve files and documents promptly and accurately upon request from attorneys and staff.
    • Assist in assembling and preparing files for court appearances, meetings, and other events.
    • Ensure proper distribution of documents to appropriate parties, both internally and externally.
    • Monitor and track the movement of files and documents to ensure their safe and timely return.

    • Perform regular audits to ensure data integrity and file accuracy.
    • Assist in the creation and maintenance of document retention policies.

  4. Administrative Support:

    • Assist with general administrative tasks, such as answering phone calls, taking messages, and directing inquiries to the appropriate person.
    • Provide support to attorneys and staff by preparing and organizing legal documents, correspondence, and other materials as needed.
    • Collaborate with other administrative personnel to ensure smooth office operations.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent. Additional education or certification in office administration is a plus.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer / BI Developer (dbt, SQL & Power BI)
locations: Europe, Latin America, Canada
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Analytics Engineer / BI Developer with strong dbt, SQL, and BI development skills to join a project focused on migrating enterprise clients from legacy reporting systems to a modern cloud-based Business Intelligence (BI) platform.

The role combines analytics engineering and BI development, with a strong focus on transforming raw data, building production-ready dbt models, optimizing SQL queries, implementing data quality tests, and developing customizable dashboards.

The ideal candidate has practical experience building end-to-end analytics solutions, from raw data sources to production dashboards, rather than primarily focusing on business analysis or product analytics.

You will collaborate with product managers, engineering teams, and client-facing stakeholders to understand reporting needs and independently deliver reliable, scalable BI solutions.

Location: Remote (EU, LATAM)
Engagement: Full-time contract
Start Date: ASAP
Experience: 5+ years
Language: English
Working hours: At least 90% overlap with US Eastern business hours is mandatory.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain production-ready data models using dbt, including staging, intermediate, and reporting layers.
  • Transform raw, unstructured or unprepared source data into reliable, well-structured reporting datasets.
  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries for large datasets.
  • Design, develop, and test reusable BI dashboard templates that support client-specific configurations.
  • Implement dbt tests, data quality checks, validation processes, and monitoring within the data transformation layer.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visual consistency between legacy and migrated dashboards.
  • Gather and analyze client reporting requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Work closely with product managers, engineers, and client-facing teams.
  • Participate in client demos, requirements discussions, and follow-up analysis.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation of dbt models, dashboard templates, configurations, and data lineage.
  • Identify project risks, manage dependencies, and communicate progress to stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience as an Analytics Engineer, BI Engineer, BI Developer, Data Analyst with a strong technical background, or Data Engineer with BI development experience.
  • 2+ years of hands-on commercial experience with dbt, including developing and maintaining production models, tests, macros, and documentation.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing production dashboards using enterprise BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, query optimization, and performance tuning for large datasets.
  • Proven hands-on experience with dimensional data modelling, including star schemas, fact tables, and dimension tables.
  • Strong experience transforming raw source data into structured, analytics-ready datasets.
  • Practical experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT and data transformation workflows.
  • Experience implementing automated data quality tests and validation checks.
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, or equivalent.
  • Experience with Git-based version control and code review processes.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to gather requirements from business users and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good English communication skills, including communication with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver results in a fast-paced environment with minimal ramp-up time.

This is a hands-on technical role. Candidates should be able to demonstrate practical project experience developing dbt models, writing advanced SQL queries, and building production BI dashboards. Experience limited to business analysis, product analytics, or reporting requirements gathering will not be sufficient.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Power BI.
  • Experience with financial services, risk management, or compliance reporting.
  • Python skills for data transformation and automation.
  • Experience migrating dashboards and reporting systems from legacy infrastructure to modern cloud-based BI platforms.
  • Experience with dashboard governance, versioning, and template lifecycle management.

What You’ll Work On

  • Migrating enterprise reporting from legacy systems to a cloud-based BI environment.
  • Developing reliable, tested, and documented production dbt models.
  • Building end-to-end data transformation workflows, from raw data to reporting-ready datasets.
  • Developing reusable dashboard templates that can be customized for different enterprise clients.
  • Ensuring migrated dashboards provide accurate and visually consistent reporting.
  • Improving reporting scalability, SQL performance, data quality, and usability.

What We Offer

  • Full-time, remote B2B contract opportunity.
  • Opportunity to work on a large-scale enterprise BI migration project.
  • Collaboration with international product and engineering teams.
  • A technically challenging project involving analytics engineering, data modelling, and BI development.
